content_of_post_to_comment: “We need to pause AI development bc we’re so super startled!!!” Likely really means “We’ve hit a scaling wall, the bubble is going to pop if we keep spending, so we’re planting the seeds of an ‘existential’ excuse for when the creditors come knocking.”
comment: The interesting split may be between genuine caution and strategic repositioning: even a real AI risk narrative can become a convenient shield when economics stop cooperating.
